pages.text: The Plant Cultivator, black-tech that "fast-forwards" seeds into crops.$(br)Its GUI has a single input slot: drop in a seed and power it up — $(2,4)the seed is NOT consumed$(0). Once the energy finishes, it spits out the plant product (but no seeds, so don't expect an infinite loop).
$(2,4)Example products$(0)$(li)Wheat Seeds → Wheat$(li)Potato → Potato$(li)Nether Wart → Nether Wart$(li)Vine / stem crops$(br2)Too slow? Stuff in upgrade components and watch it speed up.
